title: Work done by friction
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the work done against friction on the incline using W = f1 * L.

title: Speed at incline bottom
description: Essential: Correctly states the final numerical speed of the child at the bottom of the incline.

title: Minimum mat length
description: Essential: Correctly states the final numerical minimum length required for the horizontal mat.

title: Apply work-energy theorem (incline)
description: Important: Applies the work-energy theorem to the incline section, relating gravitational work, friction work, and kinetic energy.

title: Apply work-energy theorem (horizontal)
description: Important: Applies the work-energy theorem to the horizontal section, relating friction work and the change in kinetic energy.

title: Consistent unit usage
description: Optional: Uses consistent SI units (J, m/s, m) throughout the solution without conversion errors.

title: Sign error in work-energy
description: Pitfall: Uses an incorrect sign for the work done by friction in the work-energy equations.

title: Neglects incline friction work
description: Pitfall: Omits the work done against friction when calculating the speed at the bottom of the incline.
